rationale: The Lean target accurately reconstructs the displayed coefficient expressions and proves that the narrow-range right-hand-side formula equals the range-free formula plus two nonnegative contributions. That algebraic comparison follows from the paper on its intended domain, but it omits the computed product, forward-error inequality, algorithm, mixed-precision model, scaling assumptions, higher-order interpretation, and positive word-count condition. It is therefore a nontrivial-looking but definition-driven corollary that is strictly too weak to serve as a faithful formalization of Theorem 4.1 and equation (4.32).
